command: echo '=== favorites ==='; gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps 2>&1 || true; echo '=== desktop files ==='; for d in "$HOME/.local/share/applications" "/usr/share/applications"; do find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.desktop' 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do n=$(grep -m1 '^Name=' "$f" || true); e=$(grep -m1 '^Exec=' "$f" || true); if printf '%s %s %s' "$f" "$n" "$e" | grep -Eqi 'free[ -]?frank|frankenstein|frank'; then echo "FILE=$f"; grep -E '^(Name|Exec|Icon|StartupWMClass|Terminal|Type)=' "$f" || true; fi; done; done; echo '=== likely helper files ==='; find "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.claude/star" -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '/(free[-_ ]?frank|frank.*(launch|open|gui|buehne)|.*frankenstein.*(launch|open|gui|buehne))' | head -50; echo '=== service props ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus -p ExecStart -p FragmentPath 2>&1 || true; echo '=== port ==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':8788' || true; echo '=== windows ==='; command -v wmctrl >/dev/null && wmctrl -lx 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'chrome|frank|avatar|buehne' || true; echo '=== processes ==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,cmd --sort=pid | grep -E '[c]hrome|[c]hromium|frankenstein-buehne' | head -40
